title.en: Jimi Hime to Kuro Neko no, Emmanna Konyaku Haki

Ouji, Konyaku Haki Shita no wa Sochira na no de, Kowai Kao de Kocchi Niramanaide kudasai
Konyaku Haki wo Shita Reijou wa Gaman wo Tomemashita
Konyaku Hakisareta no de, Suki ni suru Koto ni Shita.
Higeki no Heroine Buru Imouto no Sei de Konyaku Hakishita no desu ga, Naze ka Seigikan no Tsuyoi Outaishi ni Karamareru you ni narimashita
Daisuki Datta Konyakusha ni Miryou no Mahou no Sei de Konyaku Hakisaremashita.
Konyaku Hakisareta Gakeppuchi Reijou wa, Teikoku no Sumeragi Otouto Denka to Musubareru
Danzaisareta Makegumi Reijou desu ga, Jikan wo Modoseru you ni Natta no de Kondokoso ni Shiawase ni narimasu
Otsubone Reijou to Shiyuka no Kisetsu
Kokurou Ou to Shirogane no Niehime
